summary_en: 76,955 shares to be cancelled (6.5% of shares outstanding pre-cancellation). Effective date 2026-09-29. Post-cancellation shares outstanding: 1,110,413. Conditional on approval of stock split resolution at extraordinary shareholders' meeting 2026-09-24.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: Yamadai Corporation announced on 27 August 2026 that its board of directors resolved to cancel 76,955 treasury shares held by the company, effective 2026-09-29, pursuant to the Companies Act section 178. The shares represent 6.5% of shares outstanding (pre-cancellation denominator 1,187,368 shares). Post-cancellation, shares outstanding will total 1,110,413. The cancellation is conditional upon approval at an extraordinary shareholders' meeting scheduled for 2026-09-24 of a separate stock-split resolution (with 2026-09-30 as the effective date for the split). The 76,955 shares constitute the entire treasury position as of 2026-08-11.
